defs.def: the physical or mental energy that you need to do sth; sth that takes a lot of energy 气力；努力；费力的事

ex.s: It bore witness to her efforts.
ex.t: 它见证了她的努力。

ex.s: If only the effort they put into avoiding responsibility could be redirected into, well, actual responsibility.
ex.t: 要是他们用来逃避责任的那份力气能转移到——嗯——真正的责任上就好了。

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

ex.s: This suggests that moments of moral effort may be part of a life that, taken as a whole, feels more satisfying.
ex.t: 这表明，道德努力的时刻或许正是这样一种生活的一部分：整体来看，它让人感到更满足。

ex.s: But when we persist with the wrong thing, every bit of effort takes us further from where we are meant to be.
ex.t: 但当我们坚持做错误的事情时，每一点努力都让我们离本该所处的位置更远。

ex.s: Putting more effort into renewables.
ex.t: 突然，外面的动静引起了他的注意。

ex.s: The importance of repeated efforts.
ex.t: 反复努力的重要性。

ex.s: I feared that my classmates might grow tired of my efforts or even lose patience with me.
ex.t: 我担心同学们可能会厌倦我的努力，甚至对我失去耐心。

ex.s: Building effective communication skills takes time, but the effects are worth the effort.
ex.t: 培养有效的沟通技巧需要时间，但效果是值得的。

ex.s: These efforts help us travel more responsibly.
ex.t: 这些努力帮助我们更负责任地旅行。

ex.s: According to this theory, people approach digital texts with a mindset suited to social media, which are often not so serious, and devote less mental effort than when they are reading print.
ex.t: 根据这一理论，人们以一种适合社交媒体的心态对待电子文本——往往不那么严肃，投入的脑力也比读纸质文本时少。

ex.s: Make joint efforts to keep it under control.
ex.t: 共同努力将其置于掌控之下。

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界，大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时，我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑，这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心，而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

ex.s: the tempting foods and our efforts to keep fit
ex.t: 诱人的食物和我们保持健康的努力

ex.s: Another issue is that the human brain is highly sensitive to wasted effort.
ex.t: 营员享受的师生比根据年龄组从1:4到1:7不等。

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算某项行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把宝贵的资源浪费在徒劳的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题是，为『塑形』而进行的规律锻炼需要持续且大量的努力——而这一切只是为了渐进的进步和不确定的回报。

ex.s: I always wanted my own efforts to be enough.
ex.t: 我总是希望自己的努力就足够了。

ex.s: How does Ms Young inspire you in her efforts to preserve Chinese Culinary traditions?
ex.t: 杨小姐如何激励你努力保存中国烹饪传统?.

ex.s: Her efforts have encouraged others to take part by running through a global campaign called“Run Blue”.
ex.t: 她的努力鼓励其他人通过一个名为"Run Blue"的全球 campaign 参与进来。

ex.s: Efforts to improve teaching at the university level have recently emerged.
ex.t: 大学层面改进教学的努力最近才出现。

ex.s: With the efforts made by all sides, we began to understand each other better.
ex.t: 经过各方的努力，我们开始更好地理解彼此。

ex.s: That can be dangerous work that could be avoided with drones assisting the crews’ efforts.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁轨或道岔造成安全问题之前检测故障。

ex.s: Although technology might make day-to-day communication possible, extra effort goes a long way on special days.
ex.t: 尽管科技或许能让日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子里，额外的努力作用很大。

ex.s: Our efforts to understand and explain the natural world are just that: efforts.
ex.t: 我们理解和解释自然界的努力仅仅是努力而已。

ex.s: Efforts in Science: Dreaming Big
ex.t: 科学努力：远大梦想

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: His efforts have resulted in 1,360 acres of naturally-grown land that has become home to many plants and animals.
ex.t: 他的努力带来了1,360英亩天然生长的土地，那里已成为许多植物和动物的家园。

ex.s: Success comes from joint efforts.
ex.t: 成功源于共同的努力。

ex.s: While Queensland Rail makes every effort to ensure trains run as scheduled，there can be no guarantee of connections between trains or between train services and bus services.
ex.t: 虽然昆士兰铁路尽一切努力确保火车按时刻表运行，但不能保证火车之间或火车与公交服务之间的衔接。

ex.s: His efforts made in vain.
ex.t: 他白费的努力。

ex.s: The good news is that it’s simple to learn and can be worth the effort.
ex.t: 好消息是学习起来很简单，而且值得付出努力。

ex.s: His efforts made in vain.
ex.t: 他白费的努力。

ex.s: His efforts made in vain.
ex.t: 他白费的努力。

ex.s: When it comes to in-person humor, effort counts a lot.
ex.t: 对于面对面的幽默来说，努力很重要。

ex.s: So even if your own efforts at humor fall short, you might be freeing the long kept humor in others.
ex.t: 所以即使你自己的幽默努力不够完美，你也可能释放了他人心中长期压抑的幽默。

ex.s: Your attitude and effort count a lot.
ex.t: 你的态度和努力很重要。

ex.s: This effort is not just a（n）   33   at being community minded—it's also a    34   measure.
ex.t: 这项努力不仅是一种具有社区意识的___33___，也是一项___34___措施。

ex.s: The environmental challenges are   48   but the efforts made by the Tanzania National Park Authority seem to be   49  .
ex.t: 环境挑战为48个，但坦桑尼亚国家公园管理局的努力似乎为49个。

ex.s: His effort to reunite families with lost medals began with a Christmas gift from his mother, a Purple Heart with the name Corrado A.
ex.t: 他让家庭与丢失勋章重聚的努力，始于母亲送的一份圣诞礼物——一枚刻着科拉多·A之名的紫心勋章。

ex.s: But if he's out there every day and playing hard, you should praise his effort regardless of whether his team wins or loses.
ex.t: 但如果他每天都在那里努力打球，无论他的球队输赢，你都应该赞扬他的努力。

ex.s: her effort to remind mom to obey traffic rules
ex.t: C．她努力提醒妈妈遵守交通规则。

ex.s: The efforts to fuel the growth of phytoplankton.
ex.t: 促进浮游植物生长的努力。

ex.s: Another possibility is that when there is a lot of talent on a team，some players may make less effort.
ex.t: 另一种可能是，当一支球队中有太多天才时，一些球员可能会不那么努力。

ex.s: Morning or Afternoon, this bike tour is the perfect tour for D.C. newcomers and locals looking to experience Washington, D.C. in a healthy way with minimum effort.
ex.t: 无论上午或下午，这次骑行游都是华盛顿新来者和当地居民以最省力、健康的方式体验华盛顿特区的完美之选。

ex.s: Whether you’re looking at wallpaper or paint, the time, effort and relative expense put into it are significant.
ex.t: 无论你是看壁纸还是油漆，投入的时间、精力和相对成本都是相当可观的。

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
ex.t: 虽然著名的外国建筑师受邀主导中国地标性建筑的设计，如新央视大楼和国家大剧院，但许多优秀的中国建筑师也在努力走向舞台中央。

ex.s: Their efforts have been proven fruitful.
ex.t: 东西方的平衡

ex.s: Because of our efforts, our daughter Georgia did decide to donate a large bag of toys to a little girl whose mother was unable to pay for her holiday due to illness.
ex.t: 由于我们的努力，女儿Georgia确实决定把一个大袋子装的玩具捐赠给一个小女孩，她的母亲因病无力支付她过节的费用。

ex.s: It saves time and effort in cooking．
ex.t: B．它节省了烹饪的时间和精力。

ex.s: A winner is one with a great effort of will.
ex.t: 更多详情请访问我们的网站www.oursac.com。

ex.s: Keep track of your efforts and write down how you feel.
ex.t: 记录你的努力并写下你的感受。

ex.s: I really don’t think it’s worth the effort of spending so much time preparing for a single meal, and then another hour cleaning up the mess after its’ over.
ex.t: 我真的不认为花这么多时间准备一顿饭，然后在结束后再花一个小时清理烂摊子是值得的。

ex.s: He performed beyond everyone's expectations with his accurate shooting and continuous efforts.
ex.t: 他凭借精准的投篮和持续的努力，打出了超出所有人预期的表现。

ex.s: Thanks to my teammates' hard efforts, I had the opportunity to show my spiking skills.” 6 Together, the Chinese women's volleyball team has fought their way through ups and downs.
ex.t: 多亏了队友们的辛勤努力，我有机会展示我的扣球技术。"6 中国女排一起经历了起起落落。

ex.s: Now, thanks to our efforts, passengers from all over the country have been enjoying these magical landscapes.
ex.t: 现在，多亏了我们的努力，来自全国各地的乘客一直在享受这些神奇的美景。

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 如果赞美是真诚的，并且专注于努力而不是结果，那么你可以像孩子做一些值得口头奖励的事情一样频繁地给予赞美。” 我们应当特别承认我们的孩子努力推动自己并努力实现一个目标，即“无恐惧地养育子女：让忧心忡忡地去关注真正重要的事情”的作者多纳休(Donahue)说。

ex.s: Taking years to complete, the Qinghai-Tibet Railway is a record of all of our efforts to overcome the most difficult engineering challenges.
ex.t: 耗时多年才完成的青藏铁路，是我们克服最艰巨工程挑战的所有努力的记录。

ex.s: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that words for your particular circumstances.
ex.t: 你可以把这些练习看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你打造适合自己特定情况的极简生活方式。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: When at last my hand would grab the edge of the pool, he would always be there with a warm, dry towel, telling me how proud he was of my desperate efforts.
ex.t: 当我终于用手抓住池边时，他总会拿着一条温暖干燥的毛巾在那里，告诉我他为我拼尽全力的努力感到多么骄傲。

ex.s: This particular feature also means we typically prefer things which offer minimum effort for maximum reward.
ex.t: 这个特别的特征也意味着我们通常更喜欢以最小的努力获得最大回报的事物。

defs.def: an attempt to do sth especially when it is difficult to do 艰难的尝试；试图；尽力

ex.s: Both efforts were overturned due to lawsuits from conservation groups.
ex.t: 这两次尝试都因保护组织的诉讼而被推翻。

defs.def: a particular activity that a group of people organize in order to achieve sth 通常置于名词后

ex.s: The innovative design requires little effort to achieve a reliable weekly supply of fresh greens.
ex.t: 这一创新设计只需很少的投入，就能实现稳定的每周新鲜蔬菜供应。

defs.def: the result of an attempt to do sth 努力的结果；成就

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 表扬努力而非结果，也意味着当孩子努力清扫院子、做饭或完成读书报告时认可她。

ex.s: Moderate effort produces the best result.
ex.t: 适度的努力产生最好的结果。

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury analysis.
ex.t: 据英国财政部分析，由于制造商们努力规避糖税，饮料中的糖含量如今减少了4500万公斤。
